news_cards.title: Bihar Mein Makhana Kisanon Ko Saugat, Automatic Popping Machine Ke Liye 5 Lakh Rupye Tak Milenga Anudan
bullets: Bihar sarkar ne makhana kisanon ke liye automatic popping machine ke liye 5 lakh rupye tak anudan dena shuru kiya hai
Is yojana ke tahat kisanon ko machine khareedne ke liye arthik sahayata milegi, jisse unki aay badh sakti hai
Yeh yojana Bihar ke kisanon ko aatmanirbhar banane aur unki aay ko badhane ke liye ek mahatvapoorn kadam hai

news_cards.title: Bihar Mein Green Chilli Subsidy, Kisanon Ko 24,000 Rupye Tak Anudan Milenga
bullets: Bihar sarkar ne hari mirch ki kheti ke liye kisanon ko 24,000 rupye tak anudan dena shuru kiya hai
Is yojana ke tahat kisanon ko hari mirch ki kheti ke liye beej, khad, aur anya saamagri khareedne ke liye arthik sahayata milegi
Yeh yojana Bihar ke kisanon ko hari mirch ki kheti ke liye protsahit karne aur unki aay ko badhane ke liye ek mahatvapoorn kadam hai

news_cards.title: Bihar Mein Nishant Kumar Ki Nazar Yuvaon Par, Gen Z Ko Jodne Ki Taiyari
bullets: Nishant Kumar, Bihar ke swasthya mantri, ne yuvaon ko apne saath jodne ke liye ek abhiyan shuru kiya hai
Is abhiyan ke tahat Nishant Kumar yuvaon ke saath sanvaad karne aur unke vicharon ko sunne ke liye taiyar hain
Yeh abhiyan Bihar ke yuvaon ko rajneeti mein shaamil karne aur unhein apne adhikaron ke prati jagruk karne ke liye ek mahatvapoorn kadam hai

news_cards.title: Bihar Mein JP Ganga Path Ko Milenga Vishwashtar Svarup, Mukhyamantri Ne Diye Nirdesh
bullets: Bihar sarkar ne JP Ganga Path ko vishwashtar svarup dena shuru kiya hai
Is yojana ke tahat Ganga Path ko viksit karne ke liye 65 kilometer ganga channel ka nirmaan kiya jayega
Yeh yojana Bihar ke parivahan vyavastha ko sudharne aur yatriyon ko suvidha pradan karne ke liye ek mahatvapoorn kadam hai

news_cards.title: Bihar Mein Mithila Makhana Ko Mila GI Tag, Pehli Baar Sea Shipment Australia Ko Kiya Gayi
bullets: Bihar ke Mithila makhana ko GI tag mila hai, jisse iske utpadan aur vyapar ko badhava milega
Pehli baar Mithila makhana ki sea shipment Australia ko ki gayi hai, jisse iske niryat ko badhava milega
Yeh yojana Bihar ke kisanon ko Mithila makhana ki kheti ke liye protsahit karne aur unki aay ko badhane ke liye ek mahatvapoorn kadam hai
